metadata.title: Stillness and Resonance
metadata.medium: Medium-format analog photography on baryta paper

exhibitionConstraints.artistAutonomyBoundary: No intrusive digital animations on top of the photograph. Sketches and interviews must appear exclusively via the overlay drawers.

chapters.narrativeText: Observe the subtle chromatic gradient between the industrial tower and the overcast sky. Analog grain gives tactile depth to the quiet horizon.

hotspots.title: Atmospheric Twilight
hotspots.description: Captured at dusk with an exposure time of 1/8s, capturing ambient sodium mist.

chapters.narrativeText: Carlos Lobo: 'I wanted to capture the lingering resonance of obsolete transmission antennas. The silence of broadcasting towers after signals cease.'

hotspots.title: Field Contact Sheet
hotspots.description: Exploratory roll film exposures taken earlier that morning before selecting this precise angle.

chapters.narrativeText: Filipa Loureiro deconstructs the artwork: 'This work bridges industrial archaeology and contemporary landscape contemplation, creating a dialogue with the museum's architecture.'

hotspots.title: Territory and Memory
hotspots.description: Historical mapping contextualizing decommissioned telecommunication infrastructure in Northern Portugal.

quickSurveyQuestions: Did this experience deepen your appreciation of the photograph?
